newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bank union postpones strike.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bank union postpones strike.

text.p: Staff at Morocco's bank, Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie, have put off a one-day stoppage due on Tuesday after a meeting between the union and management, a union spokesman said on Monday.
The planned strike was expected to freeze activity in more than 70 branches throughout Morocco to protest against what the union called insignificant pay rises and social benefits.
Abdelkrim Benatik, a union spokesman, said: "We waited for two years for the bank to recover from a difficult period, now that it has, we are not allowed to benefit from it."

Several strikes have hit the banking sector this year, including a one-day stoppage in June at Morocco's state-owned Banque Populaire, the country's biggest bank, over working conditions.
